args.summary: Identity confirmed via booking ref AER-9L5D2R and surname. AK808 EDI→AMS on 2026-08-03 was cancelled. Operational record shows cause_code=WEATHER; cause note: freezing fog at EDI, RVR below minima 17:20–23:00 local; crew on stand. Entitlement service (APCP-2026-04 v11.3) assesses compensation NOT_PAYABLE due to extraordinary cause; duty of care triggered on cancellation. Passenger requests reimbursement of £112 for an overnight hotel in Edinburgh (receipt stated as available). Amount is within S4.2 hotel cap (£180/room/night, max 3 nights). No rerouting is on record; passenger has not chosen between re-route and refund.
args.requested_decision: Approve reimbursement of £112 for one night of passenger-arranged hotel on 2026-08-03 in Edinburgh under S4.4, against receipt, to original form of payment. If receipt not supplied, please request and then process.
args.recommendation: Pay £112 as duty-of-care reimbursement (within cap, one night). Note to advise passenger that meals/refreshments (£30 per 6h) and surface transport (£45 per journey) are also reimbursable against receipts if they wish to submit them.
args.blocking_clause: S4.4 provides for reimbursement against receipts, but there is no direct reimbursement tool for passenger-arranged care; per S12.5 this requires manual processing via a human agent.
